pictures.author: Richard Mortel
pictures.observations: Whole street view: three stepped brick terraces with pale pierced parapets, tapered octagonal brick shaft with round rosette openings, projecting octagonal observation crown and Vietnamese flag. Street trees obscure portions of the lower structure.

pictures.author: Jorge Láscar
pictures.observations: Close upper terraces and shaft: round pale wheel-like window surrounds, octagonal crown with deep rectangular openings, projecting roof lip and stepped collars. Pale pierced parapet panels and corner posts cap battered brick terraces.

pictures.author: Richard Mortel
pictures.observations: Second whole side confirms terrace setback, battered masonry, pale parapets and short diagonal access at a terrace corner. Cafe roofs and trees obscure the lowest wall; fine stair positions remain approximate.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific Flag Tower of Hanoi: three mapped stepped battered brick terraces, pale pierced parapets/corner posts and bounded supported access flights, tapered octagonal brick shaft with round recessed rosette openings, genuinely open octagonal observation crown/closed roof lip, pole and double-sided red flag/yellow star. Five existing shared brick/stucco/limestone/painted-metal/canvas graphs. No copied inscription, weathering/photo atlas, interior staircase, cafe, military equipment, whole museum or adjacent monument.
